hazards.description: The wide asphalt area encourages higher vehicle speeds and creates a long, unprotected crossing distance for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Unprotected wide crossing
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross four lanes of traffic without the aid of a marked crosswalk, refuge island, or signal.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the center of the roadway

hazards.name: Lack of sidewalk buffer
hazards.description: The narrow walkway is directly adjacent to the curb, placing pedestrians in close proximity to vehicle traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Far side sidewalk along the curb

hazards.name: Degraded Sidewalk Surface
hazards.description: Significant cracking and vegetation growth create uneven surfaces and trip hazards.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Facilities
hazards.description: Complete absence of sidewalks forces pedestrians into the travel lane or onto uneven grass shoulders.
hazards.location_in_image: Both sides of the roadway throughout the visible segment.

hazards.name: High-Speed Road Geometry
hazards.description: Wide, straight travel lanes without traffic calming measures encourage higher vehicle speeds.
hazards.location_in_image: Main travel lanes in both directions.

hazards.name: Sight Line Obstructions
hazards.description: Parked vehicles and dense roadside vegetation can hide pedestrians from the view of approaching drivers.

hazards.name: Parked Vehicle Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: The parked black sedan along the curb can obstruct the visibility of pedestrians, particularly children, who may attempt to cross the street from between vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground, right side of the street.

hazards.name: Wide Roadway
hazards.description: The multi-lane configuration and wide asphalt area encourage high vehicle speeds and create long crossing distances.

hazards.name: Lack of Midblock Crossings
hazards.description: There are no marked crossing points visible for a significant distance, which may lead to unsafe midblock crossings.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Crossing
hazards.description: No marked crossings are visible across this wide, multi-lane road, increasing the risk for mid-block crossing.

hazards.name: Wide Roadway Geometry
hazards.description: The excessive width of the travel lanes and the presence of a wide painted median can encourage higher vehicle speeds in a residential context.

hazards.name: Severely degraded pavement
hazards.description: The walkway and driveway apron area are heavily cracked, uneven, and crumbling, creating significant tripping hazards.

hazards.name: Continuous vehicle conflict zone
hazards.description: The lack of a defined sidewalk separate from the driveway access points means pedestrians must share space with vehicles entering and exiting the residential area.
hazards.location_in_image: The entire length of the walkway adjacent to the buildings

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple travel lanes and a bike lane without a median refuge, increasing exposure time to vehicle traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main intersection of 18th St

hazards.name: Long unprotected crossing distance
hazards.description: The wide, multi-lane road lacks any crossing infrastructure or refuge, requiring pedestrians to cross four or more lanes of traffic unprotected.

hazards.name: Missing Sidewalks
hazards.description: There are no paved, dedicated walkways for pedestrians on either side of the road, forcing them into the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Both sides of the roadway throughout the visible area

hazards.name: Parked Vehicle Obstruction
hazards.description: A black pickup truck is parked on the paved shoulder, completely blocking the path for anyone walking along the right side of the road.

hazards.name: Wide Undefined Driveway
hazards.description: A large paved area without clear markings or narrowing creates a broad conflict zone where vehicles may cross the pedestrian path.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the brick building

hazards.name: Blank Building Frontage
hazards.description: A long windowless wall reduces natural surveillance and pedestrian comfort.
